# Archive Entry

## Summary
One member of an archive: its path, both sizes and its timestamp.

## Shape
`size` and `compressedSize` are both kept — the pair is what shows a compression ratio, and a
stored (uncompressed) member is visible as the two being equal. `name` is computed as the last
path segment so a listing can show names rather than full paths, and a trailing directory-marker
slash resolves to its own last segment rather than an empty string.

Read from the ZIP central directory, so listing an archive never inflates the payload. Consumed
by `ZipDef.archiveContents` as a `containsMany`, bounded by `FITTED_ARCHIVE_ENTRY_BUDGET`.

## Example
```ts
import { ArchiveEntryField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/zip-file-def';

@field metadata = contains(ArchiveEntryField);
```
